purpose: Image-led composition with an optional caption.
accessibility: The image is the picture; its alt text is stored in the IR as accessibility metadata (alt="" marks a decorative image) and is not drawn. The image is framed by fit: cover fills the frame and may crop, contain shows the whole image and leaves the rest of the frame in the surface colour. The caption uses the muted text token, a theme pair that meets WCAG AA, and wraps inside the safe area.
